title: PropertiesPanel: instance Color Effect (tint/brightness/alpha/advanced)
description:
The `ColorEffect` model is fully defined (`packages/core/src/engine/types.ts` line 257), interpolated in tweens, and compiled to SWF CXForm (`packages/swf/src/compile.ts`), but the SymbolInstance view in PropertiesPanel (`packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx` line 669–751) only shows Name and Blend Mode — no Color effect section.

Implement the Color Effect subsection in `SymbolInstanceView`:
- A dropdown: None / Brightness / Tint / Alpha / Advanced (matching Flash 8 Properties panel).
- For Brightness: a single -100…100 slider/input.
- For Tint: a colour swatch + a 0–100% amount input.
- For Alpha: a 0–100% input.
- For Advanced: six inputs (R/G/B mult × offset).
- Each change calls `onUpdateObject(obj.id, { colorEffect: ... })`.

Also wire canvas-preview: `renderSymbolInstance` in `packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts` currently ignores `obj.colorEffect`. Apply it using `ctx.filter` (for brightness) and CanvasRenderingContext2D compositing tricks (for tint/alpha) so the authoring canvas reflects the effect.
